text:
alex: customer sent an invoice with ~12k tokens but their SDK local estimator shows ~3.8k. account: acme-inc, invoice id INV-2026-03-15. they say no large attachments or long system prompts.

maria: ack — can you paste a minimal repro (curl or SDK) and the time window for the invoice?

alex: repro attached, time window 2026-03-14T22:00Z-2026-03-15T02:00Z. quick curl they used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"summarize: ...","stream":true}'``` they stream and then call resume in client code if connection drops.

samir: streaming + client-side resume often surfaces duplicate completions. can you confirm if their client retries or reconnects with a resume token?

alex: dev says they call client.resume() which re-sends the last chunk. local logs show some repeated "onChunk" events but not obvious duplicates in the app.

irene: meter team, can you check trace ID 0x9a3b2c for that time window? also any server-injected tokens (system/tool) that would be invisible to SDK estimate?

metering-bot: trace 0x9a3b2c received. scanning events... found sequence: initial request -> server-prefill (kv metadata) -> stream reconnect -> duplicate finalization chunk. Prefills and internal tool metadata contributed ~7.6k tokens.

billing: interesting — are prefills counted on invoice side by design? customer thought only user+assistant tokens count.

metering-bot: yes, prefill metadata and server-tool outputs are billable. in this trace we see two behaviors that amplify counts: 1) a ~3.2k token server-side prefill (KVs + routing hints) added to the session start, and 2) a streaming reconnect that caused the runtime to finalize a partial completion twice (duplicate assistant output recorded twice). combined explains the ~12k invoice.

maria: do we have reproducible steps to show duplicate finalization? alex, can you ask customer to run the same test with stream=false (non-streaming) and also capture raw request/response bytes if possible?

alex: will ask. dev also asked if the SDK estimator should account for server-prefills — right now SDK only counts user+assistant tokens and emitted tool outputs. maybe we need a warning about invisible server prefixes.

irene: agreed, docs gap. short-term: explain to customer that server-prefill tokens and duplicate finalizations are billable and provide their trace evidence. long-term: add an SDK flag to surface server-prefill estimates (approx) and detect duplicate finalizations on reconnect.

samir: engineering note: runtime emits internal prefill events with header X-Redwood-Prefill: true; meter service uses that to include tokens. if client reconnects and causes an on-complete event twice we double-charge. we should add idempotency guard keyed by session-id+finalize-seq.

alex: customer accepted explanation, asked for credit while we root cause. billing, can you propose a goodwill credit and timeframe for fix?

billing: propose 50% credit for this invoice once meter confirms duplication. will hold until eng confirms an idempotency mitigation.

metering-bot: created ticket MTR-5532 linking trace 0x9a3b2c and adding replay test. next actions: (1) eng to add idempotency guard, (2) docs to warn about server-prefills, (3) support to provide customer-facing breakdown.

maria: thanks all. alex — pls post customer-facing breakdown here when ready and paste repro results (non-stream vs stream).

alex: will do, closing loop after customer reply :thumbsup:
